gloss: double speed; fast speed; multiplied speed

definitions.explanation: A rate of playback or operation that is a multiple of the normal speed. Often used with a number prefix to specify the multiplier.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{倍速|ばいそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: To watch a video at double speed.

examples.japanese: {倍速|ばいそく}⟦{再生|さいせい}→再生：04442_saisei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{講義|こうぎ}→講義：01579_kougi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{録画|ろくが}→録画：04441_rokuga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧1.5{倍速|ばいそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{復習|ふくしゅう}→復習：01718_fukushuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I reviewed the recorded lecture by listening at 1.5 times speed.

notes:
⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧ (double, times) + {速|そく} (speed). Very commonly used in the context of video and audio playback. On its own, {倍速|ばいそく} usually means double (2x) speed, but it is frequently combined with a number to specify the exact multiplier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {倍速|ばいそく}⟦{再生|さいせい}→再生：04442_saisei⟧ — fast playback
- {倍速|ばいそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ — watch at double speed
- 1.5{倍速|ばいそく} — 1.5 times speed
- 2{倍速|ばいそく} — double speed
- 3{倍速|ばいそく} — triple speed

CULTURAL NOTE:
Watching videos and lectures at {倍速|ばいそく} has become extremely common in Japan, especially among younger generations. The term {倍速|ばいそく}⟦{視聴|しちょう}→視聴：04467_shichou⟧ (fast-speed viewing) is used in media discussions about changing consumption habits.
